-- Power from one change of the counter to the next: a meter without PIN only
-- shows whole kWh, so between two consecutive rows the power would be 0 W or a
-- spike (1 kWh in one minute = 60 kW). The average between two steps is shown
-- instead (stepBefore: from the previous step to this one). With PIN the
-- counter changes almost every row, so nothing changes there.
-- One day before the time range is read so the first interval is complete.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT timestamp_client AS ts, CAST(meter_value AS SIGNED) AS v,
         LAG(CAST(meter_value AS SIGNED)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_client) AS v_prev
  FROM sml_v1
  WHERE id = "$id" AND meter_value IS NOT NULL
    AND timestamp_client BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() - 86400 AND $__unixEpochTo()
),
c AS (
  SELECT ts, v, LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS ts_prev, LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v_cprev
  FROM r
  WHERE v_prev IS NULL OR v <> v_prev
)
SELECT ts AS time, (v - v_cprev) * 360 / NULLIF(ts - ts_prev, 0) AS "Bezug"
FROM c
WHERE ts_prev IS NOT NULL AND ts >= $__unixEpochFrom()
ORDER BY ts

-- Power from one change of the counter to the next: a meter without PIN only
-- shows whole kWh, so between two consecutive rows the power would be 0 W or a
-- spike (1 kWh in one minute = 60 kW). The average between two steps is shown
-- instead (stepBefore: from the previous step to this one). With PIN the
-- counter changes almost every row, so nothing changes there.
-- One day before the time range is read so the first interval is complete.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT timestamp_client AS ts, CAST(obis280 AS SIGNED) AS v,
         LAG(CAST(obis280 AS SIGNED)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_client) AS v_prev
  FROM sml_v1
  WHERE id = "$id" AND obis280 IS NOT NULL
    AND timestamp_client BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() - 86400 AND $__unixEpochTo()
),
c AS (
  SELECT ts, v, LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS ts_prev, LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v_cprev
  FROM r
  WHERE v_prev IS NULL OR v <> v_prev
)
SELECT ts AS time, -(v - v_cprev) * 360 / NULLIF(ts - ts_prev, 0) AS "Einspeisung"
FROM c
WHERE ts_prev IS NOT NULL AND ts >= $__unixEpochFrom()
ORDER BY ts

SELECT 
  ts_utc as time, 
  value as "CO2 g/kWh"
FROM `hz-v1`.co2_intensity_hourly 
WHERE 
  zone = "DE_LU" 
  AND $__timeFilter(ts_utc)

SELECT
  (unix_timestamp) AS "time_sec",
  price_eur_mwh/10 as "Börsenstrompreis [ct/kWh]"
FROM power_prices
WHERE
  unix_timestamp between $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
  ORDER by unix_timestamp ASC

SELECT time, PV AS "Balkon PV" FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp_client AS time,
    (meter_value_PV - LAG(meter_value_PV) OVER w) / NULLIF(timestamp_client - LAG(timestamp_client) OVER w, 0) AS PV
  FROM sml_v1
  WHERE
    id = "$id"
    AND
    $__unixEpochFilter(timestamp_client)
    -- skip rows without a myStrom value (NULL since 1.4.7, 0 from failed requests before):
    -- the delta to the last valid row gives the average power over the gap
    AND meter_value_PV IS NOT NULL AND meter_value_PV <> 0
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY timestamp_client)
) x
ORDER BY time

WITH verbrauch AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_client AS ts,
    meter_value / 10 AS wh,
    LAG(meter_value / 10) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_client) AS wh_prev,
    LAG(timestamp_client)  OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_client) AS ts_prev
  FROM sml_v1
  WHERE id = "$id"
    AND timestamp_client BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    ts,
    (wh - wh_prev) AS delta_wh
  FROM verbrauch
  WHERE wh_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND (wh - wh_prev) >= 0
),
gesamt_kwh AS (
  SELECT SUM(delta_wh) / 1000 AS total_kwh FROM deltas
),
co2_weighted AS (
  SELECT SUM(
    d.delta_wh / 1000 *
    c.value
  ) AS co2_gramm
  FROM deltas d
  JOIN co2_intensity_hourly c
    ON c.zone = 'DE_LU'
    AND c.emission_type = 'Operational'
    AND c.forecast_type = 'Actual'
    AND c.ts_utc = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(d.ts), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')
),
preis_weighted AS (
  SELECT SUM(
    d.delta_wh / 1000 *
    (p.price_eur_mwh / 1000)
  ) AS kosten_eur
  FROM deltas d
  JOIN power_prices p
    ON p.bidding_zone = 'DE-LU'
    AND p.unix_timestamp = (
      FLOOR(d.ts / 900) * 900
    )
)
SELECT
  gesamt_kwh.total_kwh                                        AS "Verbrauch (kWh)"
FROM gesamt_kwh, co2_weighted, preis_weighted;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 


  (
    (
      (3600 / 10 * (
        (SELECT meter_value FROM sml_v1 WHERE id = "$id" AND timestamp_client <= $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY timestamp_client DESC LIMIT 1) - 
        (SELECT meter_value FROM sml_v1 WHERE id = "$id" AND timestamp_client >= $__unixEpochFrom() ORDER BY timestamp_client ASC LIMIT 1)
      )) 
      / 
      (
        (SELECT timestamp_client FROM sml_v1 WHERE id = "$id" AND timestamp_client <= $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY timestamp_client DESC LIMIT 1) - 
        (SELECT timestamp_client FROM sml_v1 WHERE id = "$id" AND timestamp_client >= $__unixEpochFrom() ORDER BY timestamp_client ASC LIMIT 1)
      )
    ) * 8760
  ) AS Jahresenergie_kWh
